Single saved 'my location' anchoring Events near-me filtering + nearby-event alerts, set via device GPS or the shared MapPickerModal (the dialer's existing location-picker UI) — one location concept in this app, not a separate store; the main app has no equivalent single-location concept

Events directory tab anchored to lib/eventsLocation.ts (near-me toggle backed by MapPickerModal, tag chips, search); main app's app/events/index.tsx is a plain paginated directory with no location anchoring

Event detail/RSVP/buy/interest screen adapted from the main app's app/events/[alias].tsx to this app's auth context field names (user.display_name) and colors; adds an in-app RsvpWebViewModal (embeds the existing public /{alias}/rsvp page) for non-ticketed events since there is no JSON RSVP API — otherwise the same hashtags/gallery/info-sections/interest UI

Foreground poll of the events directory near the saved location, diffed against a locally persisted seen-id set, surfaced as a deep-linking in-app banner + tab badge (see app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx); deliberately client-side only since no push/notification backend exists for events in the standalone app

Standalone-only: embeds the existing public /{alias}/rsvp page in a WebView (same pattern as MapPickerModal) so free RSVP happens in-app without a new backend endpoint; detects success via the redirect to /rsvp/manage/.
